lesson.title: 4.5 Morning Routine
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
lesson.goal: Understand and say five morning routine actions with I, and say which room and part of the day they happen in.
lesson.grammar_function: I + routine chunk as a learned whole; + in the + room; + in the morning.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say five I routine sentences and where they happen.
